You'll track and shape legislation, build trusted relationships with lawmakers and coalition partners, and use AFP's grassroots strength to move policy forward. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $70,000–$100,000 per year. This role may also be eligible for additional bonus compensation designed to align total compensation with an employee’s overall contribution to the organization. Consistent with this approach, base salary may vary within or outside of the anticipated range based on these considerations.

Beyond individual requests, you will help build and maintain AHEAD’s knowledge assets, databases and proposal and use-case material, using scripts and automation to prepare and validate data, while continuing to grow with the industry. They will manage and support their direct reports (client services team) in order to develop and maintain a high performing team. The Director will work in partnership with the Security Leaders and Sales teams to ensure Practice deliverables to customers are complete, consistent, high quality, on time and deliver valued outcomes. jobs.description_text: The Executive Assistant serves as a trusted and highly proactive partner to one or more C-level executives at AHEAD. jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Ad Infra (Lyft Ads)
jobs.description_text: Lyft Ads is building the largest mobility media network. Brands use Lyft Ads to reach riders throughout their journeys, in the Lyft app, in the real world, and across the open web. Every time a rider opens the app, our systems decide in milliseconds which message they see, whether it’s a paid ad, an incentive, or a product message from another Lyft team. The Ad Decisioning team owns that choice. We run the serving, pacing, and auction systems behind every ad on Lyft surfaces, and we are building a first-party decisioning platform that lets paid and unpaid messages compete in a single auction based on their value to riders, advertisers, and Lyft. This platform is shared infrastructure. Ads and other teams will all use it to reach riders and drivers across multiple apps and surfaces. The work spans real-time distributed systems, auction design, and close partnership with teams across Lyft that message riders and drivers. We are looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead this team. You will spend a meaningful share of your time on technical work: shaping architecture, reviewing designs and code, and building with AI tools alongside your engineers. You will report to the Engineering Manager for Ads Infrastructure and partner closely with Product, Data Science, and a Staff engineer who leads the platform’s technical direction. Responsibilities: Lead a team of backend engineers who build and operate low-latency ad serving, pacing, and auction systems. Stay close to the code

We're a tightly integrated team of software engineers and data scientists spread across the US and Canada. Engineers and scientists work side by side to take machine learning and optimization models from research to production while scaling our systems to handle more volume. jobs.title: AI-First Engineering Intern
jobs.description_text: Why This Role Exists Xsolla is going all-in on becoming an AI-first company, and we're not waiting for a slow rollout to get there. We're offering AI Engineer Internships in regions across the globe to help drive that shift directly, not by sitting in the back office, but by building. You'll work on two things: Internal AI initiatives – helping unlock AI tooling and integrations across Xsolla faster than our existing teams can alone. Proof-of-concept builds on our own APIs – showing our product and engineering teams what's possible when you build with AI as a core part of your workflow, not an afterthought. This isn't a shadow-and-observe internship. You'll ship code that goes to customers – internal teams or external players and game developers – working closely with senior engineers and fellow interns across our global regions. Who You'll Work With You won't be isolated on an intern-only project island. You'll work closely with senior engineers who are actively rebuilding how we write software, and you'll be part of a global cohort of interns building in parallel across our regions. That combination is the point: senior engineers give you a bar for what production-grade, customer-facing code looks like, and your fellow interns give you a peer group to trade ideas, code, and AI workflows every week.

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer Position for Xsolla's Smart Wallet in Web3
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer who has tested real on-chain products — the contracts and the transactions, not only the web app in front of them. You will own quality for Xsolla's smart wallet on Xsolla ZK, our Ethereum-compatible ZK rollup: the wallet players use to hold, receive and send tokens and in-game items, signing in with the account they already have. The work runs on both sides of the chain. On the backend, you will confirm that a wallet address pre-computed from a salt is the address that actually gets deployed. On the frontend, you will follow a signed operation from the client's RPC call through the bundler to finality, and prove it landed, failed or reverted the way it should. You will fork the chain to test against real state, deploy and call contracts from the command line, and turn what you learn into automated suites. You will work in a small, senior engineering team alongside an external wallet-infrastructure partner. You can tell a defect in our code from one in a partner SDK or in the chain itself — and you bring the evidence to show which. AI coding tools are part of how you work every day, and you set them up so the rest of the team gets the same leverage.

jobs.title: Advocaat-stagiaire Banking & Finance
jobs.description_text: Het team en de functie Binnen ons Banking & Finance team werken we op dit moment met zeven advocaten. We begeleiden transacties, adviseren over financieel toezichtrecht en staan cliënten bij in procedures over onder andere zorgplicht en verhaal. Dat doen we voor banken, verzekeraars, fondsen, leasemaatschappijen, factoraars en grotere bedrijven. Samen met ons Herstructuring & Insolventie-team staan we ook bedrijven met een herstructureringsvraagstuk en hun stakeholders zijn. Ons team wordt erkend als toonaangevende praktijk in de internationale ranglijsten Legal500 en Chambers and Partners. In het afgelopen jaar heeft ons team voor meer dan EUR 8 miljard aan financieringen naar closing begeleid.
